about.title: About Trestay
about.lead: Trestay is a full-stack hotel booking platform built end to end as a learning project: a guest booking app, two operations consoles, a REST API, background workers and the Kubernetes infrastructure that runs them.
about.whatText: The project covers the whole booking journey rather than a single screen.
about.guestText: search by destination and dates, filter by price, rating and amenities, compare room types, save favourites, and complete a booking with Stripe test payments.
about.hostText: sign in to the admin console to manage properties, rooms, rates and availability, and review reservations as they arrive.
about.operatorText: use the superadmin console for platform-wide views of properties, accounts and bookings.
about.stackText: Every layer is implemented in this repository — there is no third-party booking engine behind it.
about.stackGuest: Vue 3, Vite, Vue Router, Vuex, Element Plus, i18n (English and Vietnamese)
about.stackConsole: Nuxt 4 with Pinia and Tailwind, authenticated through Keycloak
about.stackApi: Express on Node.js with a modular monolith layout, Joi validation and Swagger docs
about.stackData: MySQL (Sequelize) as the source of truth, Redis for sessions, holds and queues, and MySQL tables for analytics events
about.stackJobs: BullMQ workers for booking expiry, notifications and reconciliation
about.stackAuth: Keycloak (OIDC) with separate clients for the guest, admin and superadmin apps
about.stackInfra: k3s on a single VPS, Argo CD GitOps, Cloudflare Tunnel, images built in GitHub Actions
about.whyText: Trestay is a portfolio and learning project. The goal was to build a realistic booking product from the database schema up to the deployment pipeline, and to document the trade-offs along the way. It is not a commercial service, and the hotel data is demo content.
